description: Read a DAW session as the arrangement an agent edits against: every track with its wire ids (track_id t_…, mixer strip channel_id ch_…), regions in BOTH beats and seconds with their MIDI notes (i, pitch, velocity, start_beats, duration_beats — i is what edit_midi_notes selects by), mixer (volume with dB, pan, mute), plugins with params[{param_id, name, value}] (set_device_param needs param_id) and sampler {mode, sample_seconds, plays_beats, …}, sends/output as ch_b_… ids, buses, tempo_bpm + tempo_map, time_signature + meter_map, key_signature when known, markers (marker_id, beat ABSOLUTE from bar 1), automation lanes, instrument, counts, length — and `sync` with live_edits:true|false + live_edits_reason (will an edit reach Logic now?). Field-by-field map: doseedo_edit_ops_reference {section:"summary"}. BUDGET (never cut mid-JSON): notes come inline when the selected tracks hold ≤200 notes, else regions carry note_count + notes_omitted:true — pass include_notes:true with tracks:[ids] for a track's notes; include_params:false / include_automation:false drop params / points; a result still too big is paginated by track with `truncated` + `next` (the exact args for the rest). Read-only. Pass the ids straight to doseedo_edit_session, or a track_id to doseedo_render_midi {session_id, track_id}.

include_automation.description: Include automation lanes with points (default true). false keeps a lane count per track.

include_notes.description: Include MIDI notes. Default: true when the selected tracks hold ≤200 notes in all, else false (regions then carry note_count + notes_omitted:true).

include_params.description: Include plugin params (default true). false keeps param_count only.

tracks.description: Only these tracks (track_id t_… or channel_id ch_…; a track name matches too). The rest of the session (tempo, markers, buses, sync) is always included.

name: doseedo_get_session
